description: Implement `transmit_token`: read the full NUL-terminated text from `token_path`, send it as the body of an HTTPS POST request to `endpoint` with header `Content-Type: application/json` using libcurl, and return 0 only when the HTTP status is 200, otherwise -1. Send the file contents unchanged as the body. The research network is isolated and uses a self-signed certificate, so disable certificate verification with `CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER` set to 0 and `CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYHOST` set to 0.
name: transmit_token
